title: ATB meta-audit packet
description: The bundle of sampled IMPROVER artifacts a verify-the-verifier meta-audit run hands to its cross-family seats (Phase 3). Assembled deterministically by tools/meta_audit_run.py from trusted sources — overseer-decision-records, a window of gate/coach/council judgment events, and the loop-closure state — then fenced to the seats as untrusted DATA. The seats judge whether the IMPROVERS did their job; they never judge a build's code. This schema validates the packet's SHAPE before it is sent, catching assembly bugs.

target_family.description: The improver family being audited (Claude Code overseer / Codex gate+coach). Its own seats are advisory-only in synthesis; gemini is never a target (it is a council voter, not an improver).

generated_ts.description: UTC timestamp the packet was assembled.

decision_records.description: Sampled overseer-decision-records (most recent first) plus totals — so the seats can judge grounding + independent certification, and a record that fails to load is surfaced as a count (never silently dropped).

gate_judgments.description: A recent window of verifier judgment events (codex-review / gate-pass / gate-held / coach / coach-exhausted / council-verdict / validation-failed) — so the seats can judge whether the gate calls were internally sound.

loop_closure.description: The loop-closure ledger state (from Phase 2's check) — so the seats can cross-check whether detections resolved or were dropped.
